verdict.rationale: Logseq documents a `logseq://` protocol so third-party apps can invoke actions, including an x-callback-url quickCapture that can be bookmarked or called from the shell. It also ships a token-authenticated local HTTP API server (POST /api, CORS-enabled) that dispatches any plugin API method, with a worked curl example creating a page and block via logseq.Editor.insertBlock. Together these let scripts create and drive notes from outside the app. Missing for 10: the URI scheme is only evidenced for quick capture (no documented deep link to open a specific page or block), no OpenAPI spec or versioning policy, and no independent or hands-on corroboration.
